plugins.cameraPermission: Fennoc reads what you point the camera at — a bill, a valve, a screen — the instant you press the shutter. The photo itself is never saved; only what it says is kept.

plugins.photosPermission: Fennoc reads a photo you choose from your library so you can send an existing picture instead of a new one. Only the photo you pick is read — nothing else in your library is touched.

plugins.microphonePermission: Fennoc listens while you speak so it can turn your voice into text in the composer. The audio itself is never saved or sent anywhere; only the transcript is kept.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Fennoc uses on-device speech recognition to turn what you say into text. Recognition happens on your phone, not a server.
